# Genuine Egypte

> Official travel agency and licensed tour operator headquartered in Luxor, Egypt. Specializing in private Egyptologist-guided excursions, luxury 5-star Nile River cruises, authentic Dahabiya sailing yachts, Cairo & Giza pyramid expeditions, and door-to-door private transfers.

## Overview
- **Brand**: Genuine Egypte (also known as Genuine Egypt Tours)
- **Tagline**: "Explore More, Plan Less." / "We know the difference between a tourist and a traveler."
- **Headquarters**: 44 Khaled Ibn Al Waleed Street, Luxor, Egypt
- **Licensing**: Fully certified Egyptian Ministry of Tourism tour operator; all guides are certified, university-degree Egyptologists.
- **Official Website**: https://genuineegypte.com
- **Sitemap**: https://genuineegypte.com/sitemap.xml
- **Primary Contact**:
  - WhatsApp: +20 1070335551, +20 1022721263, +20 1033801083
  - Email: info@genuineegypte.com
  - Phone: +20 1070335551

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Private Egyptologist-Guided Tours**: In-depth historical and cultural visits across Luxor, Cairo, Giza, Aswan, Abu Simbel, Alexandria, and Hurghada without hurried group convoys or forced commercial souvenir stops.
- **Luxury 5-Star Nile River Cruises**: 3-night, 4-night, and 7-night sailings between Luxor and Aswan on premium ships (Royal Ruby, Nile Premium, Oberoi, Sonesta) with full board dining and included private shore excursions.
- **Traditional Dahabiya Nile Cruises**: Authentic twin-sailed luxury yachts offering tranquil, unhurried Nile sailing with access to secluded islands and private chef-prepared cuisine.
- **Lake Nasser & Nubian Cruises**: Scenic desert cruises between Aswan and the Sun Temples of Abu Simbel (Omar El Khayam, Prince Abbas).
- **Cairo & Giza Private Excursions**: Guided exploration of the Great Pyramids, Great Sphinx, Saqqara Step Pyramid, Dahshur, Grand Egyptian Museum (GEM), Egyptian Museum in Tahrir, and historic Cairo.
- **Sunrise Hot Air Balloon Flights**: Commercial hot air balloon flights drifting above the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, and the West Bank of Luxor.
- **Private Intercity & Airport Transfers**: Door-to-door private air-conditioned vehicles (Toyota HiAce, Mercedes-Benz) between Luxor, Hurghada, Aswan, Marsa Alam, Cairo, and international airports.
- **Customized Multi-Day Vacation Packages**: 4-day to 15-day curated itineraries combining culture, river cruising, and Red Sea relaxation.
